title: Cosmos MTO
summary: In a transformative moment for Ethiopia’s logistics sector, Cosmos MTO emerges as one of only three companies awarded a multi-modal transport license by the Ethiopian Maritime Authority.

blocks.body: In a transformative moment for Ethiopia’s logistics sector, Cosmos MTO emerges as one of only three companies awarded a multi-modal transport license by the Ethiopian Maritime Authority. This project tells the story of crafting a brand identity that seamlessly fits into various collateral while capturing the essence of the company’s mission and vision. this is a journey of creating a brand identity with a visual representation that aligns with its forward-thinking approach.
